**Downloads**
- **Windows:** `ShiftPaste-…-Setup.exe` (installs for all users; asks for admin) or the portable zip (keeps its data next to the program). Installing over an earlier 2.x keeps your data. The files aren't code-signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click *More info → Run anyway*.
- **macOS:** open the `.dmg` and drag Shift Paste to Applications. It isn't notarized: the first time, right-click the app → Open. Then allow it under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility so it can paste for you.
- **Linux:** make the AppImage executable and run it (needs GTK 3; X11 fully supported, Wayland with some limits).

Shift Paste 1.x data isn't imported automatically; 1.x is still available from the [v1.1.0 release](https://github.com/infinityhardik/shiftPaste/releases/tag/v1.1.0).
